events.note: Follow-up created while resolving the WebSocket reporter replacement; it preserves the unimplemented runtime lifecycle scope.
Activated for invocation-scoped McpProgressReporter parameter injection only.
Annotated tool functions and annotated routes now recognize and inject a fresh no-op McpProgressReporter without exposing it in client input schemas.
ToonverseTool.downloadBook now appends McpProgressReporter without emitting events.
ToonverseTool.downloadBook now emits planned, chapter, packaging, publish, completion, and failure lifecycle events to its invocation-scoped reporter; delivery remains unwired.

WebSocket calls now receive correlated notifications/progress events. The first plan starts one estimate plus configured-grace deadline; HTTP remains terminal request/response and a missing WebSocket plan is stopped by the configured default-timeout guard.
WebSocket progress now produces asynchronous notifications/progress/estimate events from a serial EWMA estimator. Observed ETA is client-only and does not alter the fixed dispatch deadline.
